steps: Log in to your KuCoin account and go to Account Security → API Management
Set a name and passphrase for your API key
Set API Key Permissions: General (for portfolio viewing)
Enable Read-Only permissions (DO NOT enable trading or withdrawal)
Optionally, restrict IP addresses for added security
Click Next and copy your API Key, Secret, and Passphrase
notes: Always keep your API Secret and Passphrase secure. Only enable the minimum permissions required for portfolio viewing.
